title: Profiles, pictures and smoother tool calls
summary: Sign in with your own profile, add a picture, pick how commands are approved, and enjoy faster, steadier tool calls.
added: Themed profiles with JPEG, PNG or animated GIF pictures, remembered login, separate local data, and settings/private skills sync.
Choose Ask for approval, Approve for me, or Bypass approval in the bar and app Settings.
Native Linux app opens the PlazCode interface in your browser with the memory helper included.
DeepSeek's own tool-call format now runs instead of showing as raw text.
Every disconnect between the app and browser is now logged with a reason, to track down random drops.
fixed: Claude and other sites now run a command about 1 second after it finishes, not up to 12 seconds later. DeepSeek keeps its safe pacing.
Helper commands answer under their own name, so results are no longer mixed up; unknown-command errors name the closest real commands.
File sizes read correctly (16 GB no longer shows as TB). Needs the new app.
Bridge: no silent drops on status checks, and a failed check refuses one request instead of cutting the link.
The PlazCode bar and collapsed tab follow the current chat box; every effort choice stays reachable.
DeepSeek messages share one queue and wait 8–9.8 seconds from the last send finishing.
Mac recovers a bridge port held by an older PlazCode; failed settings saves keep their error visible.
Startup plays once with a smooth sign-in fade, checks protected files faster, and ahead-of-stable builds show no false update error.
notes: Random bridge disconnects reported by one tester are not fully explained yet; the new logging should show the cause.
Linux automatic updates are not published yet; use complete native Linux downloads.
Windows is unsigned and Mac is not notarized, as before; your computer may ask you to confirm opening it.
